texts.zh:
我们将给你[Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

而我们只收取很少很少的[Root.GetFleet1DealCost]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]
texts.en:
We offer you [Root.GetFleet1DealProduct]

All this for the low, low price of [Root.GetFleet1DealCost]

[Root.GetFleet1DealProductAddendum]

responses.zh: 很高兴和你做生意。记住了：有梦想就一定要实现它！
responses.en: Pleasure doing business with you. And remember: don't dream it, be it!

label.zh: 现在不行，你能过后再来吗？
label.en: Not right now. Can you get back to us later?

responses.zh: 当然了。在我们离开你们的领地之前肯定会再联系你们的。但是等到那时候，交易的内容可能就不一样了……
responses.en: But of course! We will contact you again before we depart your territories. But be aware that the deal may change in that time...

title.zh: 行商舰队：范格利集团：最后提议
title.en: Caravan Fleet: The Vengralian Trium: Last Call

texts.zh: 你真的打算就这么让一生只会出现一次的机会白白溜走吗？
texts.en: Are you ready to seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, before it's gone forever?

texts.zh: 我们虽然很快就会分别，但是你可以永远持有我们的完美产品。
texts.en: We must soon part, but you can keep our excellent products with you forever.

texts.zh: 你要是不做这笔买卖那可就大错特错了。你再好好动脑子想想。
texts.en: You understood that you would be a fool to pass up this deal. You can now make good on that wisdom.

texts.zh: 亲爱的顾客，或者我应该说朋友？我们正准备离开你们的领地。请问您是否有兴趣再最后一次看看我们的产品呢？当然不会是真正的最后一次，我们以后也会来的。
texts.en: Dear customers - or dare we say friends? - we are departing your territories. May we interest you in our wares, one last time? Until next time, that is.

texts.zh: 这可是最后机会了，专门为你量身打造的订单！你肯定会感兴趣的！
texts.en: Last chance to strike this deal, tailored to your needs! You don't want to miss it!

responses.zh: 很高兴和你做生意。记住了：有梦想就一定要实现它！
responses.en: Pleasure doing business with you. And remember: don't dream it, be it!

texts.zh: 我们摧毁了四处招摇撞骗的范格利集团！他们的劣质产品与溜须拍马的言行将不再污染这片星系。
texts.en: We have destroyed the wheedling pests of The Vengralian Trium! No longer will their inferior products and ingratiating mannerisms pollute the galaxy.

notes.zh: 评注：本国舰队歼灭这支车队时（on_fleet_destroyed_perp）弹出，给舰队指挥官添加特质，并通知其他帝国（cara.1003）。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when the empire's fleet destroys this caravan (on_fleet_destroyed_perp); it gives the fleet's leader a trait and notifies other empires (cara.1003).

texts.zh: 我们得知范格利集团已经立即关闭了其移动门市，因为该行商已被彻底消灭了。
texts.en: We have received word that The Vengralian Trium is shuttering its mobile storefront effective immediately, due to the caravan being utterly annihilated.

texts.zh: 我们限量向私人实体出售布洛葛腺体。适用于各类半透膜！
texts.en: We have a very limited quantity of Blorg glandular extract available for purchase by private entities. Great for semi-permeable membranes of all kinds!

texts.zh:
人生在世总有悲伤失意之时。但是我立马就会想起，财富和幸福就在转角处等候！

告诉你的朋友们吧！
texts.en:
Sometimes it all seems so hopeless. But then I remember that wealth and happiness are just around the corner!

Tell your friends!

texts.zh:
巴尼斯营养液不是用人做的。

配方保密，但绝对健康。
texts.en:
Baneth Nutritional Slurry is NOT people.

The ingredients are secret, and very healthy.

texts.zh: 请注意，可能包含范格利废料标签的意思是说，生产该产品的设施也用作处理范格利废料，不是说这东西是范格利废料。
texts.en: Please note that the MAY CONTAIN TRACES OF VENGRALIAN WASTE stickers only indicate that the product is produced in facilities that also handle Vengralian waste, not that the product itself is Vengralian waste.

texts.zh: 我们始终欢迎下游经销商加盟。有兴趣加入范格利集团吗？
texts.en: We're always on the lookout for more downline distributors. Care to join the Trium family?

texts.zh: 你完全可以信任范格利的品质。
texts.en: You can trust the Vengralian Seal of Quality.

texts.zh: 申请退款说明买家不够信任产品。但我们充分确信麾下产品的质量。
texts.en: Offering refunds betrays a lack of confidence in your products. We have full confidence in our products.

texts.zh: 我们教外星物种坐地生财之道。
texts.en: We teach xenos how to earn a substantial additional income working from home.

texts.zh: 跟产品本身无关，关键是产品能带来多少利益。
texts.en: It's not about the products, it's about the benefits of purchasing the products.

texts.zh: 你知不知道有什么智慧生物需要一些额外的能量币收入啊？
texts.en: Do you happen to know any intelligent sapients that could use an additional stream of energy credits?

texts.zh: 虽然我们的产品根本不愁销路，但我们依然愿意花时间把它卖给您。
texts.en: While our products practically sell themselves, we will also take the time to sell them. To you.

texts.zh: 拜托了，买点什么吧。随便买点什么都行。
texts.en: Please buy something. Anything. Just... Please.

texts.zh: 范格利集团中没有老板，人人都是自己的老板。虽然这确实会带来一些……管理上的麻烦。
texts.en: Every member of the Vengralian Trium is their own boss. This does lead to some... administrative issues.

texts.zh:
范格利集团的目标就是让这世界上没有难做的生意。这是范格利的立命之本。不想做生意的想法都是……

错的。

所以……
texts.en:
The Vengralian Trium was created for commerce. It is in the Vengralian blood-analogue. Not engaging in commerce is...

Wrong.

So...

texts.zh: 就算是最古老的范格利历史收据也提到了奥伦星商人。他们提升了我们，让我们的文明从孩提时代跃进到购买他们的厨房用品。
texts.en: Even the oldest Vengralian history-receipts tell of the Orlan Star Merchants. They elevated us from beasthood to sell us kitchen appliances.

texts.zh: 范格利集团的传说就是奥伦星商人的传说。他们虽然已经不在了，但是早已规定的规定的销售指标必须达成！
texts.en: The legacy of the Vengralian Trium is also the legacy of the Orlan Star Merchants. They are no longer with us, but the prescribed quotas must still be met!

label.zh: 先给我们看看你打算用什么来交易。

notes.zh: 评注：车队穿越国境进入本国（on_crossing_border → cara.1010，同一帝国540天内只触发一次）时，若与其有通讯、本国不嗜杀且没有打开的外交窗口，便弹出交易菜单；初次接触时则是 cara.1020。
notes.en: Commentary: when the fleet crosses into the empire (on_crossing_border -> cara.1010, once per 540 days per empire) and the empire is in communication, not homicidal and has no open diplomacy window, the trade menu opens; at first contact cara.1020 shows instead.

summary.text:
# 行商舰队：范格利集团 / Caravan Fleet: The Vengralian Trium

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/caravaneer_events.txt:1294-1960`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1114-1117,1656`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

这支车队（The Vengralian Trium）在银河中依次访问若干个国家的首都（视银河国家数量定1–10个，cara.1000）；穿越他国国境时触发交易菜单 cara.1100；初次接触（first_contact 的结束阶段）时弹出自我介绍 cara.1020。

The caravan fleet (The Vengralian Trium) tours the capitals of a number of empires (1–10 depending on the number of empires, cara.1000); crossing a border triggers the trade menu cara.1100; at the end of first contact the introduction cara.1020 shows.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

cara.1020（初次接触）或 cara.1100（穿越国境）→ cara.1200 交易：每次现生成一份交易（cara_generate_deal1），可以成交、选“以后再说”或拒绝。选“以后再说”→ 这支车队下次穿越国境时发出 cara.1251“最后一次机会”。

cara.1020 (first contact) or cara.1100 (border crossing) -> cara.1200 the deal: a fresh deal is generated each time (cara_generate_deal1) and can be taken, postponed or refused. Postponing -> the next time this fleet crosses a border it offers cara.1251 "last call".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

成交 / 以后再说 / 拒绝或退出；本国歼灭车队则走 cara.1002 / cara.1003（通知）。

Take the deal / later / refuse or leave; destroying the fleet leads to cara.1002 / cara.1003 (notices).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

交易内容和价格由脚本本地化 GetFleet1DealProduct / Cost 现场决定；嗜杀帝国只有“去死”式退出。

Deal product and cost are produced by the scripted localisation GetFleet1DealProduct / Cost; homicidal empires only get the "Die..." exit.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了行程、国境触发、首次接触入口、最后一次报价与被歼灭处理；三支车队的脚本逐行相同，仅数字不同。原先分开的3张卡（1002、1020、1250）并入本故事。

Route, border trigger, first-contact entry, last offer and destruction handling were checked; the three fleets use identical scripts with different numbers. The former three cards (1002, 1020, 1250) are merged here.
